rooms.name: Test Tavern
rooms.description: A cozy tavern with wooden beams and a warm fire. Good place to start testing.
rooms.navigation_description: You can go north to reach the village square, or exit through the tavern entrance.

rooms.name: Village Square
rooms.description: A bustling village square with a fountain in the center.
rooms.navigation_description: You can go south to return to the tavern, east to the forest path, or west to the general store.

rooms.name: Forest Path
rooms.description: A quiet path through the woods. Birds sing in the distance.
rooms.navigation_description: You can go west to return to the village square.

rooms.name: General Store
rooms.description: A small shop selling various adventuring supplies.
rooms.navigation_description: You can go east to return to the village square.
